description: Raid: Convoy Strike: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: An {enemy} supply convoy is crossing {system}. Four freighters, strong escort. Take the freighters.
Convoy strike. {client} wants the cargo ships stopped, whatever it costs.
Raid on a heavy convoy. Eight escorts, four haulers.
success: The freighters are burning. A clean strike.
The enemy supply line is cut for now.
failure: The convoy gets through. {client} writes the raid off.
You are beaten back. The convoy sails on.
radio-convoy: Convoy ahead. Four freighters, eight escorts.
There they are. Heavy escort. Go for the haulers.
Convoy in sight. Do not waste time on the guards.
radio-support: Four more ships closing on the right.
radio-picket: Bombers on your rear. Kill them.
